title: 弹琴
author: 刘长卿
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【弹琴】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。
tr: 涼室無外響，空桑七弦分。所彈非新聲，俗耳安肯聞。月落未終曲，暗中泣湘君。如傳我心苦，千里蒼梧雲。

theme: 《弹琴》主旨在于写田园生活之趣，表达淡泊自适的人生志趣。；反映民生疾苦，表达对百姓的同情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代刘长卿的代表性作品之一。

The seven strings of Kongsang ring distinct and clear.
What I play is no fashionable new tune,
How could worldly ears deign to stop and hear?
The moon has set before the song ends,
In the dark the Xiang goddess seems to weep.
As if conveying the sorrow within my heart,
Like clouds over Cangwu a thousand li deep.

title: 新年作
author: 刘长卿
note: 《新年作》是刘长卿的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【新年作】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。

en_body: My homesick heart grows more urgent at the new year,
At the edge of heaven alone my tears fall free.
Old age has come, yet I live beneath others,
Spring returns before this traveler can flee.
With mountain apes I pass both dawn and dusk,
With river willows I share mist and wind.
I am like Jia Yi, exiled to Changsha,
How many more years must I here remain?

在天涯我独自潸然落泪。
年纪老大却还屈居人下，
春天已经归来我却仍在异乡为客。
岭上的猿猴与我朝夕相伴，
江边的柳树和我共沐风烟。
我已经像被贬为长沙王太傅的贾谊，
从今往后还要在这里度过多少年。

Old age has come, yet I live beneath others,
Spring returns before this traveler can flee.
With mountain apes I pass both dawn and dusk,
With river willows I share mist and wind.
I am like Jia Yi, exiled to Changsha,
How many more years must I here remain?

title: 江州重别薛六柳八二员外
author: 刘长卿
note: 【江州重别薛六柳八二员外】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。
tr: 生涯豈料承優詔，世事空知學醉歌。江上月明胡鴈過，淮南木落楚山多。寄身且喜滄洲近，顧影無如白髮何。今日龍鍾人共棄，媿君猶遣慎風波。

en_body: In this life I never expected to receive an imperial edict of grace,
Amid world's affairs I vainly learned to sing drunk in distress.
Over the river the moon is bright as wild geese fly past,
In Huainan leaves fall, and Chu's mountains seem numberless.
I rejoice to find shelter near Cangzhou's shores,
Yet gazing at my white hair there is naught I can do.
Now worn with age, discarded by all the world,
I am ashamed you still warn me to beware life's rough tide.

baihua_lines: 这一生哪里料到还能承蒙皇帝的恩诏，
世事纷乱只知学着醉酒狂歌。
江上月色明亮胡雁正飞过，
淮南树叶飘落楚地的山峰显得格外多。
暂且为能寄身靠近沧洲而欣喜，
看着镜中的白发却无可奈何。
如今我老态龙钟被世人遗弃，
惭愧你们还叮嘱我要当心宦海风波。

title: 秋日登吴公台上寺远眺
author: 刘长卿
note: 【秋日登吴公台上寺远眺】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。

en_body: After plants shed their leaves upon the ancient terrace,
In autumn daylight I gaze out with a homesick heart.
Few visitors come to this temple in the wilds,
Cloud-capped peaks are parted by waters deep and far apart.
The setting sun lingers upon the old ramparts,
Cold chime tones fill the empty woods all around.
The Southern Dynasties' past stirs such melancholy,
Only the Long River flows on to this day, unbound.

南朝往事令人无限惆怅，
只有长江独自流淌至今。

title: 自夏口至鹦鹉洲夕望岳阳寄源中丞
author: 刘长卿
note: 【相思】彼此思念，多指男女之间或友人之间的深切思念。；【自夏口至鹦鹉洲夕望岳阳寄源中丞】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。

en_body: Upon the sandbar no waves rise, no mist drifts by,
The longing of this Chu traveler grows ever more vast.
By Hankou's setting sun birds wing obliquely across,
Dongting's autumn waters stretch to meet the sky at last.
A lone town pressed against the hills sounds cold bugle calls,
At a lonely garrison by the river my boat moors at night.
Jia Yi submitted petitions grieving for the Han house,
Exiled to Changsha, he moves all ages to pity his plight.

baihua_lines: 鹦鹉洲上没有波浪也没有烟霭，
我这楚地客子的相思之情愈发渺远。
汉口的夕阳中鸟儿斜斜飞过江面，

贾谊当年上书是为汉室担忧，
被贬到长沙古往今来都令人哀怜。

title: 送上人
author: 刘长卿
note: 《送上人》是刘长卿的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【送上人】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。
tr: 孤云将野鹤。岂向人间住。莫买沃洲山。时人巳知处。
appr: 《送上人》是唐代刘长卿所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「孤云将野鹤。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《送上人》历代传诵不衰，是刘长卿诗歌风格的集中体现。

title: 送李中丞归汉阳别业
author: 刘长卿
note: 【送李中丞归汉阳别业】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。
tr: 流落征南将，曾驱十万师。罢归无旧业，老去恋明时。独立三边静，轻生一剑知。茫茫江汉上，日暮欲何之。

en_body: This general who campaigned in the south now wanders adrift,
Once he commanded a hundred thousand troops in the field.
Dismissed, he returns without any old estate to his name,
Now old, he still longs for the enlightened sovereign's weal.
Alone he stood, and the three borders grew peaceful and still,
He valued life lightly, and his sword alone knew his true worth.
Upon the vast, boundless waters of Han and Yangtze,
As the sun sets, where will you go across the earth?

title: 送灵澈
author: 刘长卿
note: 【青山】青翠的山峦，常象征永恒、宁静与归隐。；【送灵澈】唐代刘长卿所作的诗。

author: 刘长卿

en_body: For three years of exile you dwelt here in this place,
Through ten thousand ages only the sorrow of a Chu guest remains.
Alone I seek your traces amid autumn grass after you were gone,
In cold, barren woods only see the slanting sun that wanes.
Emperor Wen of Han was wise, yet his favor to you was thin,
The Xiang River knows not feeling, how could it know your lament?
In this silent land where mountains and rivers shed their leaves,
I pity you—what wrong led you to this far, distant tent?

en_body: I watch your vessel sail into the vast misty waters,
I wave farewell, and tears wet the cloth at my wrist.
The flying bird vanishes into the distance, who knows where,
Only green mountains stand empty, facing those who part, mist-kissed.
A single sail grows distant upon the Long River,
The setting sun lights spring upon the Five Lakes.
Who can see that here upon this sandbar,
I pine for you, grieving over the white duckweed that breaks?

en_body: Clouds lift, and Hanyang City comes into view far off,
My lone sail still has a full day's journey ahead to go.
The merchant naps by day, knowing waves are calm and still,
The boatmen chat at night, sensing the rising tide's flow.
In Sanxiang's autumn hues my temples have turned gray,
My heart yearns home ten thousand li toward the bright moon's glow.
My old homestead has perished entirely in war's ravage,
How can I bear more, hearing war drums on the river blow?

更哪堪江上传来阵阵战鼓之声。

This time of parting fills the heart with sorrow deep and keen.
Your road leads out beyond the cold, drifting clouds,
I turn to return just as evening snow begins to fall between.
Orphaned young, I became a wanderer early in life,
After so much hardship, I met you all too late, I ween.
We cover our faces and weep, facing each other in vain,
Amid the dust of the world, when shall we meet again, I mean?

离别之时正令人不胜伤悲。
你的道路伸向寒云之外，
我归来时正值暮雪纷飞。
年少丧父很早就漂泊在外作客，
历经多难才与你相识实在太迟。
掩面哭泣徒然地相向而立，
风尘扰攘不知后会在何期。

en_lines: Withered grass spreads everywhere across our homeland passes,
This time of parting fills the heart with sorrow deep and keen.
Your road leads out beyond the cold, drifting clouds,
I turn to return just as evening snow begins to fall between.

After so much hardship, I met you all too late, I ween.
We cover our faces and weep, facing each other in vain,
Amid the dust of the world, when shall we meet again, I mean?

How many years have mountains and rivers kept us apart?
Meeting so suddenly, I half suspect I am dreaming,
We grieve and ask each other how old we have grown, at heart.

Over damp bamboos mist and haze silently drift and start.
Worse yet, the sorrow that tomorrow we must part again,
We cherish this farewell cup, passing it hand to heart.

baihua: 世乱同南去，时清独北还。他乡生白发，旧国见青山。晓月过残垒，繁星宿故关。寒禽与衰草，处处伴愁颜。

Now peace returns, you alone go back to the northern plain.
In strange lands your hair has turned white with passing years,
Returning home, you will find only the green hills remain.
By the dawn moon you will pass ruined fortresses,
Under a sky of stars you will lodge at old passes again.
Cold birds and withered grass along your journey,
Everywhere will accompany your sad face in its pain.

This makes me long all the more for my old friend,

At Yuliang ferry the crowd jostles and clamors to cross.
People follow the sandbank toward the riverside village,
I too take my boat and return to Lumen, my moss.
The moon over Lumen lights the trees veiled in mist,
I suddenly arrive at Lord Pang's old hermitage lost.
The rock door and pine path have long been still and quiet,
Only the recluse comes and goes here, free of frost.

All the valleys suddenly grow dim and dark and still.
The moon amid the pines brings coolness to the night,
The wind-blown spring fills every ear with its clear thrill.
The woodcutters are nearly all gone home now,
Birds in the evening mist have just settled on the hill.
You promised to come and lodge here this very night,
With my lute I wait on the vine-wreathed path until.

我抱着琴在萝径上等候。

en_body: I will send no more memorials to the northern palace gate,

Moonlight through pines fills my window, empty of refrains.

baihua_lines: 不要再给北阙上书求仕了，
回到南山我那破旧的茅屋。
我没有才能被圣明的君主弃用，
身体多病往日的朋友也疏远了。
白发催人年岁渐老，
新春逼近一年又将过去。
满怀愁绪难以入眠，
松间的月光照进窗棂一片空寂。
baihua: 北阙休上书，南山归敝庐。不才明主弃，多病故人疎。白发催年老，青阳逼岁除。永怀愁不寐，松月夜窗虚。
en_lines: I will send no more memorials to the northern palace gate,
I shall return to my tattered hut in the Southern Mountains.
Lacking talent, I was rejected by the wise sovereign,
Fallen ill, old friends have grown distant, their memory wanes.
White hairs press on, hastening the coming of old age,
The spring sun presses on as another year fully wanes.
Ever burdened by sorrow, I cannot find sleep at night,
Moonlight through pines fills my window, empty of refrains.

en_body: My homeward horse rides beyond the white clouds,
Winding and winding out past the mountains before.
After today comes tomorrow, then another day,
I know in my heart there will never be peace anymore.
I thank you for coming in your official robes to see me off,
I wish to return while orioles sing and flowers bloom at the door.
Every step I take, I turn my head to look back once,
Slowly, slowly making toward the nearest pass, so poor.

title: 秋登兰山寄张五
author: 孟浩然
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【秋登兰山寄张五】唐代孟浩然所作的诗。
tr: 北山白雲裏，隱者自怡悅。相望試登高，心飛逐鳥滅。愁因薄暮起，興是清秋發。時見歸村人，沙行渡頭歇。天邊樹若薺，江畔舟如月。何當載酒來，共醉重陽節。

en_body: The northern peaks rise amid white clouds that drift,
There the hermit dwells, finding joy in his own way.
To gaze toward you, I climb to a high vantage point,
My heart flies after the birds until they vanish in the day.
As twilight falls, a melancholy rises in my breast,
The clear autumn air rouses my spirits, I must say.
Now and then I see villagers returning home,
Walking the sand, resting at the ferry landing bay.
Trees on the horizon look as small as shepherd's purse,
Boats by the shore seem tiny as a crescent moon's ray.
When will you come, bringing wine with you here,
That we may drink drunk together on Double Ninth Day?

隐居的人在此自得其乐。
为了眺望你我试着登上高处，
心随飞鸟远去直到消失在天边。
薄暮时分愁绪渐渐升起，
清秋时节兴致油然而发。

走过沙滩在渡头歇息。

江畔的船只小得像一弯新月。
什么时候你能载酒前来，
我们一起共醉重阳佳节。

title: 秦中感秋寄远上人
author: 孟浩然
note: 【秦中感秋寄远上人】唐代孟浩然所作的诗。
tr: 一丘常欲臥，三徑苦無資。北土非吾願，東林懷我師。黃金然桂盡，壯志逐年衰。日夕涼風至，聞蟬但益悲。

en_body: I have often longed to rest in hills and dales,
But lack the means to plant my three garden paths.
Staying in the north for office is not my heart's desire,
I yearn for you, Master, at Donglin Temple, aftermaths.
My gold is all spent, dear as cassia wood fuel here,
My lofty ambitions fade with each year that hath.
At dusk a cool wind begins to blow,
And hearing cicadas only deepens my wraths.

baihua_lines: 我常想归隐山林一丘一壑，
苦于没有置办三径的资财。
留在长安求仕并非我的心愿，
我心中怀念东林寺的您这位高僧。
黄金在桂薪般昂贵的长安花费已尽，
壮志也随着年岁逐渐衰减。
傍晚凉风吹来，
听到蝉鸣只增添我的悲伤。

en_lines: I have often longed to rest in hills and dales,
But lack the means to plant my three garden paths.
Staying in the north for office is not my heart's desire,
I yearn for you, Master, at Donglin Temple, aftermaths.
My gold is all spent, dear as cassia wood fuel here,
My lofty ambitions fade with each year that hath.
At dusk a cool wind begins to blow,
And hearing cicadas only deepens my wraths.

author: 孟浩然

en_body: An old friend prepared chicken and millet rice,
Inviting me to his cottage in the fields, we meet.

Blue hills slant beyond the city wall, complete.

Raising our cups we chat of mulberry and hemp, wheat.
Wait until the Double Ninth Festival comes around,
I will come again to drink with you and chrysanthemums greet.

title: 与高适薛据登慈恩寺浮图
author: 岑参
note: 【与高适薛据登慈恩寺浮图】唐代岑参所作的诗。

en_body: The pagoda rises as if welling up from the earth,
Standing lone and tall, piercing the palaces of heaven.
Climbing it, one emerges beyond the world of men,
Stone steps spiral upward into the empty skies even.
Lofty and abrupt, it presses down upon the sacred land,
Soaring and rugged, as if carved by ghostly hands, riven.
Its four corners block the brilliant sun itself,
Its seventh story brushes against the dome of heaven.
Looking down, one can point to high-flying birds,
Bending an ear, one hears the rush of the wind striven.
The rolling ranges resemble waves upon the sea,
Rushing eastward as if paying homage to the ocean, leavened.
Green locust trees line the imperial carriageway,
Palaces and pavilions appear so exquisitely woven.
Autumn colors come rolling in from the west,
Pale and blue, filling all Guanzhong, unshriven.
Upon the northern plain where the Five Tombs lie,
For ten thousand ages green mists have been cloven.
The pure truth of Buddhism here can be fully grasped,
Good karma has long been what I have striven.
I swear I will hang up my official cap and retire,
For enlightenment brings blessings that never are riven.

baihua_lines: 宝塔宛如从地下涌出，
孤高地高耸直入天宫。
登临塔顶仿佛超出尘世之外，
石阶盘旋而上直入虚空。
突兀挺拔压盖神州大地，
峥嵘鬼斧神工令人惊叹。
四角高耸遮挡了白日，
七层塔顶摩挲着苍穹。
向下窥看可以指点高飞的鸟儿，
俯身倾听可闻迅疾的风声。
连绵的群山好似波涛起伏，
奔腾向东如同朝宗于海。
青苍的槐树夹着驰道，
宫殿楼阁何等精巧玲珑。
秋色从西方滚滚而来，
苍苍莽莽铺满了关中大地。
五陵所在的北原之上，
万古以来都是青苍迷蒙。
清净的佛理在此全然了悟，
善因夙来就是我所尊崇的。
我发誓将辞官挂冠归隐，
觉悟佛道将受用无穷。

en_body: Cocks crow on the purple roads, dawn light is cold,
Orioles sing in the capital as spring draws to its end.
Morning bells at the golden palace open ten thousand gates,
By the jade steps the imperial guard surrounds officials, friend.
Flowers greet sword pendants as the stars begin to fade,
Willows brush the banners while dew still does not bend.
Only you, the guest at the Phoenix Pool, Jia Zhi,
Your song of White Snow makes composing in response hard to mend.

en_translation: Cocks crow on the purple roads, dawn light is cold,
Orioles sing in the capital as spring draws to its end.
Morning bells at the golden palace open ten thousand gates,
By the jade steps the imperial guard surrounds officials, friend.

title: 寄左省杜拾遗
author: 岑参
note: 《寄左省杜拾遗》是岑参的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【寄左省杜拾遗】唐代岑参所作的诗。
tr: 聯步趨丹陛，分曹限紫微。曉隨天仗入，暮惹御香歸。白髮悲花落，青雲羨鳥飛。聖朝無闕事，自覺諫書稀。

At dawn we enter with the imperial retinue in file,

Gazing at blue clouds I envy birds their free flight overall.
In this sagely court there are no faults to be corrected,
I feel that my remonstrance memorials grow fewer, and small.

title: 白雪歌送武判官归京
author: 岑参
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【白雪歌送武判官归京】唐代岑参所作的诗。
tr: 北風捲地白草折，胡天八月即飛雪。忽然一夜春風來，千樹萬樹梨花開。散入珠簾濕羅幕，狐裘不煖錦衾薄。將軍角弓不得控，都護鐵衣冷難着。瀚海闌干百丈冰，愁雲黲淡萬里凝。中軍置酒飲歸客，胡琴琵琶與羌笛。紛紛暮雪下轅門，風掣紅旗凍不翻。輪臺東門送君去，去時雪滿天山路。山迴路轉不見君，雪上空留馬行處。

theme: 《白雪歌送武判官归京》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代岑参的代表性作品之一。
en_body: North winds sweep the earth, snapping white grass blades,
In the borderlands, already in the eighth month snow fills the skies.
Suddenly it is as if a spring breeze came overnight,
And thousands of pear trees bloomed before our eyes.
Snowflakes drift through pearl curtains, dampening silk screens,
Fox fur robes bring no warmth, brocade quilts feel thin likewise.
The general's horn bow is too frozen to draw,
The protector's iron armor is too cold to wear, to our surprise.
Across the vast desert ice stretches a hundred fathoms deep,
Sorrow-laden clouds hang frozen for ten thousand miles, no cries.
In the central camp wine is set to see the traveler home,
Hu lutes, pipas, and Qiang flutes play their melodies, sighs.
At dusk heavy snow falls thick outside the camp gate,
In the biting wind the red flag is frozen, it cannot rise.
At Luntai's eastern gate I see you off on your way,
As you leave, snow covers the roads to the Heavenly Mountains' size.
The road twists, the mountains turn, and you are lost from sight,
Only hoof prints remain in the snow, marking where you said goodbyes.

title: 走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征
author: 岑参
body: 君不见走马川行雪海边，
note: 【走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征】唐代岑参所作的诗。
tr: 君不見走馬川行雪海邊，平沙莽莽黃入天。輪臺九月風夜吼，一川碎石大如斗，隨風滿地石亂走。匈奴草黃馬正肥，金山西見煙塵飛。漢家大將西出師，將軍金甲夜不脫。半夜軍行戈相撥，風頭如刀面如割。馬毛帶雪汗氣蒸，五花連錢旋作冰。幕中草檄硯水凝，虜騎聞之應膽懾。料知短兵不敢接，車師西門佇獻捷。

en_body: Have you not seen Zouma River, by the Sea of Snow?
Where vast yellow sands stretch upward to the sky.
In Luntai in the ninth month, fierce winds roar at night,
Stones in the river bed are as large as pecks, oh my!
They roll and tumble everywhere across the ground,
Driven by the howling gale that passes by.
The Xiongnu grass is yellow, their horses fat and strong,
West of the Golden Mountains dust and smoke rise high.
The great general of Han leads his army west on campaign,
At night the general never takes off his golden armor, nigh.
They march at midnight, spears and halberds clashing,
Wind cuts like a knife, slicing faces as they sigh.
Snow on horsehair mingles with steaming sweat, on dappled coats it freezes into ice in the blink of an eye.
In the tent they draft dispatches, inkstone water frozen,
When the enemy hears this, their courage should die.
I know they will not dare to meet us in close combat,
We shall wait at the west gate of Jushi for victory to draw nigh.

en_title: 走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征
baihua_lines: 你难道没有看见走马川就在雪海旁边，
茫茫黄沙一直连接到天边。
轮台九月里狂风在夜间怒吼，
满川的碎石大如斗，
被狂风吹得满地乱滚。
匈奴牧草黄壮战马正是肥美的时候，
金山以西已经看到烟尘飞扬。
汉朝的大将率兵向西出征，
将军夜里都不脱下金甲。
半夜行军戈矛互相碰撞，
风头如刀刮在脸上如同切割。
马毛上挂着雪汗气蒸腾，
五花连钱斑纹的马身上转眼就结成冰。
军帐中起草檄文砚水都冻结了，
敌人听到这些应该会胆战心惊。
料想他们不敢短兵相接前来迎战，
我们在车师西门等待献上捷报。

en_body: Above Luntai's walls the horn sounds through the night,
North of the city the Maotou star has fallen from the sky.
Urgent dispatches passed Quli last night, we hear,
The Chanyu's armies have come west of the Golden Mountains high.
From the watchtower westward dust darkens all the air,
Han troops have encamped north of Luntai, standing by.
The great general grasps the staff and marches west,
At dawn the flutes blow as the great army passes by.
War drums beat on four sides like a surging sea of snow,
The three armies' great shout shakes Yin Mountain, nigh.
War spirit at enemy camps rises up to the clouds,
White bones on the battlefield twist among grass roots, dry.
On Jian River wind blows fierce, snowflakes wide and thick,
At Shakou stones are frozen, horses' hooves slip and die.
Lord Imperial Secretary, you labor hard for the throne,
Vowing to repay your lord and pacify the border's cry.
Who has not seen names written in history since old times?
Today your deeds and fame shall all the ancients outvie.

baihua_lines: 轮台城头夜里吹起了号角，
轮台城北旄头星已经陨落。
紧急军书昨夜就过了渠黎，
单于的军队已经到了金山以西。
戍楼上向西望烟尘黑压压一片，
汉军已经屯驻在轮台以北。
大将手持旄节向西出征，
黎明时分吹起大军出发。
四面战鼓擂动如同雪海涌起，
三军大呼阴山都为之震动。
敌军营垒杀气直冲云霄，
战场上白骨缠绕着草根。
剑河风急雪片宽阔，
沙口石冻马蹄都能脱落。
御史大夫您为王室勤劳王事甘受苦辛，
发誓要报答君主平定边尘。
古来青史留名谁没有见过，
今日看您的功名胜过古人。

en_body: Emperor Wen of Han built this high terrace to gaze at immortals,
Today I climb it as the dawn light begins to spread.
Clouds and mountains of Sanjin all turn toward the north,
Wind and rain from the Two Tombs come rolling from east instead.
The gatekeeper at Hanguguan—who can recognize him now?
The immortal Old Man of the River is gone, never to tread.
I wish to seek you out nearby, like Tao of Pengze,
That we may drink together in joy, o'er chrysanthemum cups bread.

baihua_lines: 汉文帝在这里修筑了高高的望仙台，
今日我登临台上曙色刚刚散开。
三晋一带的云山都朝向北方，
二陵的风雨从东边滚滚而来。

河上公这位仙翁一去不再回来。

一同开怀畅饮共醉菊花酒杯。

title: 孤雁
author: 崔涂
note: 《孤雁》是崔涂的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【孤雁】唐代崔涂所作的诗。
tr: 葦岸風吹雨，沙汀月照霜。還同我兄弟，零落不成行。（見《能改齋漫錄》卷八。全詩八句，此爲後四句。

【合·收束】末2句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。

title: 除夜有怀
author: 崔涂
note: 【相思】彼此思念，多指男女之间或友人之间的深切思念。；【除夜有怀】唐代崔涂所作的诗。

en_body: The bell and water clock at fifth watch seem to urge each other on,
The four seasons turn and change, cycling around again.
In the curtained bed the dying lamp's flame has just gone out,
Incense in the brazier has burned entirely to ash, no gain.
Gradually I feel spring draw near my lotus-embroidered pillow,
Suddenly the cold vanishes from the bamboo-leaf wine cup's reign.
Every family staying up to watch the year must still be awake,
In my longing, how can my dream-soul travel to your domain?

相思之情中梦魂又怎能来到你身边。

Gradually I feel spring draw near my lotus-embroidered pillow,
Suddenly the cold vanishes from the bamboo-leaf wine cup's reign.

For a thousand years white clouds drift idly in the air.

隐居的地方只有孤云相伴。
松林梢头露出一弯微月，
清淡的月光依然照在你身上。
茅亭里花影仿佛在此安睡，
种药的院落长满了青苔纹。
我也想要辞去世俗隐居，
与西山的鸾鹤为伴为伍。
baihua: 清溪深不测，隐处唯孤云。松际露微月，清光犹为君。茅亭宿花影，药院滋苔纹。余亦谢时去，西山鸾鹤群。
en_lines: The clear stream is deep, its bottom hard to measure,
At this hermitage only lonely clouds come and go.
A faint moon peeks through the edges of the pine trees,
Its clear light still shines on you, as if it knows.
In the thatched pavilion flower shadows seem to sleep,
The herb garden is overgrown with moss that grows.
I too would bid farewell to the world's affairs,
To dwell with phoenixes and cranes the west mountains know.

Frontier soldiers lean against the watchtower wall.
Spring breeze blows over Wang Zhaojun's green tomb,
The white sun sets over Liangzhou, casting its pall.

Travelers roam freely to the far borderlands, all.
The hearts of the Tibetan people are like this water,
Forever willing to flow south toward the Chinese hall.

吐蕃的民意就像这流水，
永远愿意向南流向中原。
baihua: 调角断清秋，征人倚戍楼。春风对青冢，白日落梁州。大汉无兵阻，穷边有客游。蕃情似此水，长愿向南流。
en_lines: The sound of bugles cuts through the clear autumn,
Frontier soldiers lean against the watchtower wall.
Spring breeze blows over Wang Zhaojun's green tomb,
The white sun sets over Liangzhou, casting its pall.
Across the great desert no weapons block the way,
Travelers roam freely to the far borderlands, all.
The hearts of the Tibetan people are like this water,
Forever willing to flow south toward the Chinese hall.

title: 感遇·其一
author: 张九龄
note: 《感遇·其一》是张九龄的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【感遇·其一】唐代张九龄所作的诗。
tr: 兰叶春葳蕤，桂华秋皎洁。欣欣此生意，自尔为佳节。谁知林栖者，闻风坐相悦。草木有本心，何求美人折！
appr: 《感遇·其一》是唐代张九龄所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《感遇·其一》历代传诵不衰，是张九龄诗歌风格的集中体现。
st:
【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。
img:
【风】风意象，春风主喜乐，秋风主悲愁，东风送春，西风送秋。

【草】草意象，春草生意，秋草萧瑟，常喻离愁与岁月。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
bg: 《感遇·其一》为唐代张九龄所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者张九龄在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《感遇·其一》主旨在于托物言志，借物抒怀，表达品格追求。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代张九龄的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Orchid leaves grow lush and abundant in spring,
Cassia blossoms shine bright and pure in autumn air.
They flourish, full of life and vibrant spirit,
Naturally making their seasons sweet and fair.
Who would have thought the hermits dwelling in the woods,
Catching their fragrance on the wind, would love them there?
Plants and trees have their own inborn nature true,
Why should they seek a beauty's hand to pluck them, where?

桂花在秋天皎洁明亮。
它们欣欣向荣充满生机，

又何必要美人来攀折呢！
